beta_reproduction_rule: ROUND_HALF_UP to 0.01 international J/g; unrounded absolute difference <=0.005 is also recorded.
human_review_status: AI-assisted document and table review; no independent human sign-off
nist_gamma_policy: The measured gamma values are frozen as raw calorimetric physics constraints, not direct enthalpy labels. A coupled model may impose gamma = DeltaH_vap + T*V_m*dp_sat/dT using only training-visible pressure information and model derivatives.
nist_published_L_policy: The 14 Osborne-Ginnings published L=gamma-beta values are sensitivity-only because beta is pressure-derived, two exact cited slope lineages remain unavailable, and 7 of 14 beta values are not reproduced at the printed 0.01 int J/g precision from the accessible archival inputs.
pressure_independence_definition: Not inferred from a pressure-temperature slope/correlation or corrected using benchmark pressure labels. Raw gamma constraints are a separate coupled-physics tier and never count as direct H labels.
primary_label_policy: Only verified direct enthalpy labels that satisfy the inherited v0.3 pressure-independence and provenance policy count toward the primary training gate.
review_scope: Archival reconstruction of the 14 NIST beta corrections, pressure-source overlap audit, final tier decision, and freeze of raw gamma constraints. No model fitting and no split changes.
